title: Integration Requirements
description:
Stage 9 artifact for the business_requirement path (FR-035, AI §9.1). Generated against the Stage 6 architecture and the context set.

EVERY INTEGRATION NAMES THE SYSTEM, THE COMPONENT, THE PURPOSE AND THE DIRECTION (FR-035), and the API capabilities it demands. Constraints are labelled by provenance: `stated` cites the context element that stated it; `general_knowledge` is what the model knows of the platform, which the knowledge-currency note covers — platform capabilities change, and the reader is told to verify (O-4). Uncertainty is disclosed in `uncertainties`, never asserted as a capability.

The pipeline refuses an integration with a system the architecture does not name, and a document that omits one the architecture does name. A design with no external system carries `no_integrations_statement` and an empty list.

system.description: The external system, as the architecture names it.

component.description: The architecture component that integrates it.

capabilities_required.description: What the system's API must offer for this integration to work.

context_index.description: Present exactly when provenance is stated.

uncertainties.description: What is not known about the system's current capability and must be verified before building.

no_integrations_statement.description: Present when integrations is empty: why this design touches no external system.

knowledge_currency_note.description: Always present: platform capabilities, limits and pricing change; verify before committing (O-4).
